blocks.text: ReLEAF · Every farmer a biomanufacturer · GEMS Taiwan, iGEM 2026
blocks.zh: ReLEAF · 每位農友都是生物製造者 · GEMS Taiwan, iGEM 2026

blocks.en: Every farmer a biomanufacturer. ReLEAF is a stress-responsive optogenetic bioreactor for precision plant protection: from stress prediction to protectant delivery in one integrated system, with the engineered cells kept inside it. GEMS Taiwan, iGEM 2026, Biomanufacturing Village.
blocks.text: Every farmer a biomanufacturer. ReLEAF is a stress-responsive optogenetic bioreactor for precision plant protection: from stress prediction to protectant delivery in one integrated system, with the engineered cells kept inside it. GEMS Taiwan, iGEM 2026, Biomanufacturing Village.
blocks.zh: 每位農友都是生物製造者。ReLEAF 是一套逆境響應式光遺傳生物反應器，用於精準的植物保護：從逆境預測到保護劑施用整合於同一套系統，而工程化細胞始終留在系統之內。GEMS Taiwan，iGEM 2026，生物製造村。

blocks.en: Every Farmer a Biomanufacturer
blocks.zh: 每位農友都是生物製造者

blocks.en: Empowering future farmers to combat climate change with a Stress-Responsive Optogenetic Bioreactor for Precision Plant Protection
blocks.text: Empowering future farmers to combat climate change with a Stress-Responsive Optogenetic Bioreactor for Precision Plant Protection
blocks.zh: 賦能未來的農友因應氣候變遷， 以逆境響應式光遺傳生物反應器實現精準植物保護

blocks.en: As long as it benefits the plants and does not disrupt the balance of nature, I am very willing to try any new technology. This gives me more time to do what I love most — farming.
blocks.text: As long as it benefits the plants and does not disrupt the balance of nature, I am very willing to try any new technology. This gives me more time to do what I love most — farming.
blocks.zh: 只要對作物有益、不破壞自然的平衡， 任何新技術我都很願意試。 這讓我有更多時間做我最愛的事——務農。

blocks.en: The weather swings hardest where Taiwan farms most.
blocks.text: The weather swings hardest where Taiwan farms most.
blocks.zh: 臺灣農業最密集的地方，天氣也擺盪得最劇烈。

blocks.en: Farmer Chen
Farmer Chen in Tamsui told us how climate stress directly affects crop health and yield.
blocks.text: Farmer Chen in Tamsui told us how climate stress directly affects crop health and yield.
blocks.zh: 淡水的 Farmer Chen 告訴我們，氣候逆境如何直接影響作物的健康與產量。

blocks.text: Her experience reflects a larger pattern across Taiwan, where heat stress is becoming an increasing challenge for agriculture.
blocks.zh: 她的經驗反映了全臺更大的趨勢：熱逆境正成為農業日益嚴峻的挑戰。

blocks.en: Even when farmers see the stress, protection can still remain out of reach.
blocks.text: Even when farmers see the stress, protection can still remain out of reach.
blocks.zh: 即使農友看見了逆境，保護仍可能遙不可及。

blocks.en: Crop-protection products already exist, but for many small-scale farmers, access can still depend on cost, availability, and getting the right treatment in time.
blocks.text: Crop-protection products already exist, but for many small-scale farmers, access can still depend on cost, availability, and getting the right treatment in time.

blocks.text: From stress prediction, protein production, separation and delivery in one integrated system.The whole unit measures 400 × 240 × 620 mm.

blocks.text: On-demand Green light switches production on when the environmental sensors and forecasts decide to.

Predict local stress A leaf sensor monitors leaf temperature and wetness, which combines with the weather forecast. Our predictive AIoT (artificial intelligence of things) model turns the data into a stress index and predicts when stress will become too high for the crop, so the farmer sees it on the ReLEAF app and can prepare ahead.
blocks.text: Predict local stress A leaf sensor monitors leaf temperature and wetness, which combines with the weather forecast. Our predictive AIoT (artificial intelligence of things) model turns the data into a stress index and predicts when stress will become too high for the crop, so the farmer sees it on the ReLEAF app and can prepare ahead.
blocks.zh: 預測當地逆境 葉片感測器量測葉溫與葉面濕潤度，再與天氣預報結合。我們的預測式 AIoT（人工智慧物聯網）模型把這些數據轉成逆境指數，並預測逆境何時會高到作物承受不住，農友在 ReLEAF App 上看到，就能提前準備。

blocks.en: Green light activation When predicted stress approaches the threshold, the farmer approves the run on the app and the system activates 520 nm green light, switching on the CcaSR optogenetic circuit in engineered B. subtilis.
blocks.text: Green light activation When predicted stress approaches the threshold, the farmer approves the run on the app and the system activates 520 nm green light, switching on the CcaSR optogenetic circuit in engineered B. subtilis.
blocks.zh: 綠光啟動 當預測的逆境接近閾值，農友在 App 上核准這次運轉，系統便開啟 520 nm 綠光，啟動工程化枯草桿菌（B. subtilis）中的 CcaSR 光遺傳迴路。

blocks.en: Produce the protectant The engineered B. subtilis responds to the light signal by producing plant-protective proteins inside the bioreactor.
blocks.text: Produce the protectant The engineered B. subtilis responds to the light signal by producing plant-protective proteins inside the bioreactor.
blocks.zh: 生產保護劑 工程化的枯草桿菌依光訊號作出反應，在生物反應器內生產具植物保護功能的蛋白質。

blocks.en: Retain the bacteria, release the product The culture circulates through a hollow-fiber membrane that retains the engineered bacteria while allowing smaller soluble protectants to pass into the harvest bottle.
blocks.text: Retain the bacteria, release the product The culture circulates through a hollow-fiber membrane that retains the engineered bacteria while allowing smaller soluble protectants to pass into the harvest bottle.
blocks.zh: 留住細菌，放出產物 菌液循環通過中空纖維膜，膜把工程化細菌留下，讓較小的可溶性保護劑通往收集瓶。

blocks.en: Collect, dilute, spray The farmer collects the protectant from the harvest bottle, dilutes it with water by the factor the app states, and sprays it on the crop by hand, before the stress reaches the crop. Spraying by hand is how the system is used now; delivery through irrigation is a possibility for later. No laboratory skills are needed.
blocks.text: Collect, dilute, spray The farmer collects the protectant from the harvest bottle, dilutes it with water by the factor the app states, and sprays it on the crop by hand, before the stress reaches the crop. Spraying by hand is how the system is used now; delivery through irrigation is a possibility for later. No laboratory skills are needed.
blocks.zh: 收集、稀釋、噴施 農友從收集瓶取出保護劑，依 App 指示的倍數加水稀釋，在逆境傷到作物之前以人工噴施。目前的使用方式是人工噴施；日後也可能透過灌溉系統輸送。全程不需要實驗室技能。

blocks.en: Switch off production Once the predicted stress has passed, 660 nm red light switches the circuit off again, reducing unnecessary protein production and metabolic burden.
blocks.text: Switch off production Once the predicted stress has passed, 660 nm red light switches the circuit off again, reducing unnecessary protein production and metabolic burden.
blocks.zh: 關閉生產 預測的逆境過去之後，660 nm 紅光把迴路再關上，減少不必要的蛋白質生產與代謝負擔。

blocks.en: Green light switches on the CcaSR circuit in Bacillus subtilis, and the cells secrete the protectant
blocks.text: Green light switches on the CcaSR circuit in Bacillus subtilis, and the cells secrete the protectant
blocks.zh: 綠光開啟 Bacillus subtilis 中的 CcaSR 迴路，細胞便分泌保護劑

blocks.en: Make the pigment
ho1 and pcyA turn the cell’s heme into phycocyanobilin, which the light sensor needs.
blocks.text: ho1 and pcyA turn the cell’s heme into phycocyanobilin, which the light sensor needs.
blocks.zh: ho1 與 pcyA 把細胞的血基質轉成藻藍膽素（phycocyanobilin），這是光感測器需要的輔基。

blocks.en: Sense the light
Green light (520 nm) switches CcaS on in the membrane. Red light (660 nm) switches it off.
blocks.text: Green light (520 nm) switches CcaS on in the membrane. Red light (660 nm) switches it off.
blocks.zh: 綠光（520 nm）在細胞膜上開啟 CcaS，紅光（660 nm）把它關閉。

blocks.en: Switch the gene on
CcaS passes a phosphate to CcaR, and the CcaR dimer turns on the output gene.
blocks.text: CcaS passes a phosphate to CcaR, and the CcaR dimer turns on the output gene.
blocks.zh: CcaS 把磷酸基傳給 CcaR，CcaR 二聚體接著開啟輸出基因。

blocks.en: Secrete the protectant
The cell makes the protectant and secretes it into the medium. The output slot takes multiple protectants for different plant stresses.
blocks.text: The cell makes the protectant and secretes it into the medium. The output slot takes multiple protectants for different plant stresses.
blocks.zh: 細胞製造保護劑，並把它分泌到培養液中。輸出位可以換成對應不同植物逆境的多種保護劑。

blocks.en: We didn’t shape ReLEAF in isolation.
blocks.text: We didn’t shape ReLEAF in isolation.
blocks.zh: ReLEAF 不是我們關起門來做出來的。

blocks.en: Local Farmers
Grounded us in real agricultural needs.
blocks.text: Grounded us in real agricultural needs.
blocks.zh: 讓我們扎根在真實的農業需求上。

blocks.en: Academic Experts
Helped us refine the science and engineering.
blocks.text: Helped us refine the science and engineering.
blocks.zh: 幫我們把科學與工程設計磨得更準。

blocks.en: Industry Stakeholders
Showed us the barriers between production and access.
blocks.text: Showed us the barriers between production and access.
blocks.zh: 讓我們看見生產與可得性之間的阻礙。

blocks.en: Built from the needs of one farm, one field at a time.
blocks.text: Built from the needs of one farm, one field at a time.
blocks.zh: 從一座農場、一塊田地的需求開始建起。

blocks.en: Every farmera biomanufacturer.
blocks.zh: 每位農友都是生物製造者。

blocks.en: Toward a future where plant protection lies in each farmer’s hands.
blocks.text: Toward a future where plant protection lies in each farmer’s hands.
blocks.zh: 朝向植物保護握在每位農友手中的未來。

attrs.en: The ReLEAF team in their team shirts walking in single file between bean trellises on Farmer Chen’s farm in Tamsui, with Chen at the head of the line.
attrs.zh: ReLEAF 團隊穿著隊服，在淡水 Farmer Chen 農場的豆架之間排成一列前行，Chen 走在最前面。

attrs.en: The bench circulation loop with its in-line photometer, in a glass-fronted cabinet: a media bottle of yellow B. subtilis culture on a stirrer, the peristaltic pump, the black photometer tower and a breadboard, with plants on the shelf above.
attrs.zh: 檯面上的循環迴路與線上光度計，放在玻璃門櫃裡：攪拌器上一瓶黃色的 B. subtilis 菌液、蠕動幫浦、黑色光度計塔與一塊麵包板，上層架上擺著植物。

attrs.en: The CcaSR circuit in four modules.

The four-module CcaSR circuit in B. subtilis. Module 1, heme converted to phycocyanobilin by ho1 and pcyA. Module 2, CcaS in the membrane binding phycocyanobilin and autophosphorylating under green light, reversed by red light. Module 3, phosphate passed to CcaR, which dimerises. Module 4, the CcaR dimer driving transcription and translation of the protectants, which are then secreted.
attrs.zh: 枯草桿菌中的四模組 CcaSR 迴路。模組 1，血基質由 ho1 與 pcyA 轉成藻藍膽素。模組 2，細胞膜上的 CcaS 結合藻藍膽素，在綠光下自磷酸化，紅光使其逆轉。模組 3，磷酸基傳給 CcaR，CcaR 形成二聚體。模組 4，CcaR 二聚體驅動保護劑的轉錄與轉譯，保護劑隨後被分泌出去。

attrs.zh: Farmer Chen 跪在淡水的田裡，手邊放著籃子，向兩位 ReLEAF 學生指出土裡的幼苗。

attrs.zh: Prof. Chang 指著一張「Prototype 2 Design」生物反應器投影片，穿著隊服的 ReLEAF 學生在一旁聆聽。

attrs.en: At CH Biotech, a researcher in a white coat explains something to two ReLEAF students, who listen closely.
attrs.zh: 在 CH Biotech，一位穿白袍的研究人員向兩位專注聆聽的 ReLEAF 學生講解。

attrs.en: A drawing of first light over a valley of small farms: fields of every colour with a river down the middle, terraced hills on either side and mountains behind, the sun rising over a ridge on the right. Farmhouses stand among trees and betel palms, with rice paddies, an orchard, net houses, a truck and farmers in conical hats at work. In almost every field a small bioreactor is lit green, and the light it throws falls on that field and no other.
attrs.zh: 一幅晨光初照小農山谷的畫：各種顏色的田地、中間一條河、兩側的梯田山坡，後方是群山，太陽從右側稜線升起。農舍立在樹木與檳榔樹之間，還有水稻田、果園、網室、一輛貨車，以及戴斗笠工作的農友。幾乎每一塊田裡都有一台小型生物反應器亮著綠光，而它投出的光只落在自己那塊田上。

attrs.en: At the 5 September forum booth, a ReLEAF student leans over the black bioreactor cabinet, its tubes lit green, while two visitors bend in to look; the team’s poster stands to the left.
attrs.zh: 9 月 5 日論壇攤位上，一位 ReLEAF 學生俯身在黑色生物反應器櫃前，櫃內管路亮著綠光，兩位參觀者靠近觀看；團隊海報立在左側。

attrs.en: Two hands holding up a pair of square agar plates of Arabidopsis seedlings: the left plate carries two dense rows of green seedlings with long roots, the right plate a sparse row of small, pale ones.
attrs.zh: 雙手舉起兩塊方形的阿拉伯芥瓊脂培養盤：左盤有兩列茂密的綠色幼苗，根系很長；右盤只有一列矮小蒼白的幼苗。

attrs.en: The ReLEAF system running on one bench: a hollow-fiber column on a stand, culture and medium bottles, a peristaltic pump, the in-line photometer and a laptop showing a live growth curve, under a whiteboard sketch of the circuit and the bioreactor loop.
attrs.zh: 整套 ReLEAF 系統在同一張實驗檯上運轉：架上的中空纖維管柱、菌液與培養液瓶、蠕動幫浦、線上光度計，以及顯示即時生長曲線的筆電，上方白板畫著迴路與生物反應器的草圖。

attrs.en: The team’s light plate apparatus inside a steel incubator: a white 3D-printed block of culture tubes on its black LED base, the tubes glowing green at visibly different brightness.
attrs.zh: 鋼製培養箱裡的團隊光照板裝置：白色 3D 列印的培養管座放在黑色 LED 底板上，管內的綠光亮度明顯不同。

attrs.en: Farmer Chen cooking at a camp stove as two ReLEAF students watch beside her.
attrs.zh: Farmer Chen 在露營爐上煮食，兩位 ReLEAF 學生在一旁看著。
